title: Inspect the Map
goal: Inspect a value in a HashMap without cloning the entry string.
hints: Mapping with s.as_str() yields Option<&str> without allocating.
explanation: `map.get(key)` returns `Option<&String>`. Mapping `s.as_str()` converts the borrowed reference into `Option<&str>` with zero heap clones. Choosing `.cloned()` or `.map(|s| s.clone())` returns `Option<String>`, causing a type mismatch `E0308` with `Option<&str>`.
